name: Comparison
description: Side-by-side comparison section in six shapes: before/after images (static or with a draggable reveal slider), a head-to-head A-vs-B property table, method cards with pros/cons, a horizontal bar chart, or a multi-criteria star-rating matrix. Each variant reads its own field group.
when_to_use: Whenever two or more options, states, or methods must be contrasted — renovation before/after, product A vs. B, alternative approaches, or benchmark values. Use Table for pricing/spec data without a comparative framing.
capabilities: before/after image pair, static side-by-side or with pointer-draggable reveal handle
head-to-head table: two contenders with per-row values and pos/neg/neu tone coloring
method cards with two metrics plus pros/cons lists
horizontal bar chart with unit, max value, notes, and highlight flag
star-rating matrix scoring items against a shared criteria list

variants.description: Two labeled images side by side with captions and meta lines. Default.
Before/after stacked in one frame with a draggable reveal handle (pointer events).
A vs. B: names, taglines, images, and h2h_rows[] with tone-colored values.
Method cards (methods[]) with tagline, two metrics, and pros/cons lists.
Horizontal bar chart from bars_rows[], scaled to bars_max, labeled with bars_unit.
Matrix rating each rating_items[] entry 1-5 against the rating_criteria lines.

breakpoints.mobile: Cards and table columns stack; the slider variant stays a single draggable frame.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column pairs; methods render as a 3-card row.

ai.prompt_summary: Comparison: contrast section. Settings: variant (before-after|slider|head-to-head|methods|bars|ratings), eyebrow, headline, intro. Per variant: before_/after_ label+caption+meta+image (before-after, slider); h2h_a_/h2h_b_ name+tagline+image plus h2h_rows[] { property, a_value, a_tone (pos|neg|neu), b_value, b_tone } (head-to-head); methods[] { name, tagline, metric1/2 label+value, pros, cons — one per line } (methods); bars_unit, bars_max plus bars_rows[] { label, value, note, highlight } (bars); rating_criteria (one per line) plus rating_items[] { name, values (comma-separated 1-5) } (ratings).
ai.content_guidelines: Keep row/criteria labels to 2-4 words. 4-7 h2h rows or bars; 3 method cards; 3-6 rating criteria. Tones: pos for the advantage, neg for the drawback, neu otherwise.

field_hints.rating_items.values: Comma-separated 1-5 scores in the exact order of the rating_criteria lines.
field_hints.bars_max: Bars scale relative to this value — set it at or slightly above the largest row value.
field_hints.methods.pros: One point per line; rendered as a checkmark list (cons as crosses).
